long_biography.plain_text:
Restaurateur Klaus Rader serves on the advisory board of kinderherzen Stiftung München. The foundation supports research and treatment for children with congenital heart conditions in Munich and Bavaria, including less invasive procedures at the Deutsches Herzzentrum München. His role accompanies L’Osteria’s sustained fundraising relationship with the organisation.

At L’Osteria, Rader initially handled finance and concept development while his business partner managed restaurant operations. He favoured analytical decisions, while his partner placed greater trust in instinct. When McWin acquired a majority stake in 2023, he retained a significant minority interest and continued contributing through the supervisory board.
